title: Store a currency on each order
body: We start selling in GBP next month, so orders need a currency. Every existing order is EUR, and new orders default to EUR.

labels.note: The migration adds currency as NOT NULL with no server_default. On a table that already has rows, Postgres rejects the ALTER TABLE, so the deploy fails. The ORM default="EUR" applies only to new inserts from Python and does not backfill. It needs server_default="EUR", or a nullable add, a backfill and then NOT NULL.
